description: Discovers running Windows Docker containers and collects state, health, CPU, memory, network, block I/O and process metrics.
technicalNotes: Requires a Windows Collector. Connects to system.hostname with PowerShell Remoting (wmi.user / wmi.pass) and runs the Docker CLI on the host; set docker.path if docker.exe is not on the host PATH. When devices are added by IP, the Collector must list them in WinRM TrustedHosts. The account needs access to the Docker engine pipe (local Administrators by default). Instances are keyed on container name.
name: Windows_Docker_Containers
